title: The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
edition: As on 21 May 2025; incorporating amendments including the Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act, 2018
sourceNote: Official (India Code). The current consolidated PDF is expressly marked 'As on the 21st May, 2025' and incorporates the 2018 amendments, including Sections 7, 7A, 8, 9, 10, 13 and 17A.

titleHi: उत्तर प्रदेश नि:शुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार नियमावली, 2011
sourceNote: Official (India Code; Uttar Pradesh State Rules). The official copy states that these Rules were made under section 38 of the RTE Act, 2009 and superseded earlier rules and orders on the subject.

title: National Health Mission — Uttar Pradesh State Programme Implementation Plan / Record of Proceedings, FY 2024-25 & FY 2025-26
issuer: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / Government of Uttar Pradesh
sourceNote: Official (National Health Mission Uttar Pradesh). The current PIP page lists the 2024-25 and 2025-26 ROP/PIP material; the signed administrative approval records approval of Uttar Pradesh's two-year NHM State Programme Implementation Plan.

title: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana — Operation Manual
sourceNote: Official (National Health Authority). The manual covers PM-JAY implementation, State Health Agencies, monitoring, capacity building, fraud control, grievance redressal and operational coordination.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY — Revised Empanelment and De-empanelment Guidelines and Ready Reckoner
sourceNote: Official (National Health Authority). The guideline establishes the framework for State Health Agencies to empanel healthcare providers and conduct disciplinary/de-empanelment proceedings.
